entries.2feb98a724c2b669: A highly effective consulting service that goes beyond recommending mere strategy or concept formulation, premised on subsequent system implementation and practical business use. With engineers participating from the strategy-planning stage, strategy can be formulated with development and operation in view, and the formulated strategies are linked to 0th-Order System Development and the 0th-Order Lab.
entries.61bc12f968a18cab: Major companies in various industries (end users)
entries.8cd5118aaa64e2b5: A service that moves away from conventional person-month-based support, with dedicated teams of engineers versed in specific specialized fields, such as generative AI, cybersecurity, data science and UI/UX design, providing solutions. Fees are set based on the value of the solutions provided, not merely on the volume of work.
entries.91e878a8e8692b59: The company group, made up of the company and two consolidated subsidiaries (A.K. Plus Co., Ltd. and WhiteBox Co., Ltd.), operates a single segment, the DX Business. It consists of '0th-Order System Development', which realizes customers' DX; '0th-Order Lab', which provides solutions on a team basis; '0th-Order Consulting', which formulates strategies with development in mind; and the 'WhiteBox' platform, which realizes DX in the system development industry. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥8,019 million. From the current consolidated fiscal year, the company group has shifted to consolidated accounting.
entries.92678d53a3e37eb1: System development companies and freelance engineers
entries.a6ec5380549ee625: A DX-related company that supports large companies' in-house DX through agile "Phase 0 system development," in which customers and engineers collaborate.
entries.bafd29720206873b: This service has customer employees, the company's engineers and partners working together to resolve operational issues through system development, and it handles exclusively direct transaction projects with customers (end users). Leveraging the features of agile development (Scrum development), which allows projects to start even before requirements are fixed, the service is used in areas such as building application prototypes, system integration, smartphone app development and operation, and migrating system infrastructure to the cloud. Revenue from contracts with customers was ¥7,985 million.
